summary: All automated verification checks against live production (mcp.mnemonik.xyz v0.2.3, @mnemonik-xyz/mcp@0.2.3, GitHub Release v0.2.3) PASS. Anonymous discovery confirms 7 prompts, 7 resources, 7 tools with enriched Purpose/Trigger descriptions on 6 skill-backed tools; initialize.embedder is non-empty with model_id=all-MiniLM-L6-v2, model_version=0.1.0-fastembed-5.13.2, dim=384. Production health endpoint returns 200 ok. SHA256 of GitHub Release tarball matches SHA256SUMS byte-for-byte. Sigstore attestation verifies cleanly against repo mnemonik-xyz/monorepo with signer workflow .github/workflows/release.yml. Five manual-only items remain for user verification (fresh-machine npm install, Claude Code /mcp menu visibility, live OAuth browser popup, airplane-mode local sign on Apple Silicon, MCP Inspector visual smoke screenshot). Verdict 'partial' is procedural: every check this agent CAN run from a development machine is green; the remaining items are deferred-to-user per T12 + T11 audit by design (require fresh-machine state and human-eye observation).

gh attestation verify mnemonic-mcp-v0.2.3-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz --repo mnemonik-xyz/monorepo → exit 0. Attestation JSON inspection confirms buildDefinition.externalParameters.workflow.path = '.github/workflows/release.yml' (matches the publisher pin required by Decision 8) and runnerEnvironment = 'github-hosted'. NOTE: current gh CLI rejects simultaneous --owner + --repo flags as mutually exclusive (flag group conflict introduced after the shim's install-binary.ts was authored); the shim's hardcoded both-flags command will fail on this gh version. Tracked as follow-up below (does not block this v0.2.3 release — the production attestation itself is valid and verifiable).

manual_steps_for_user.steps: On a clean macOS machine: 1) `npm install -g @mnemonik-xyz/mcp` — verify success, no postinstall errors; 2) `mnemonik-mcp install --check` — verify shows the install plan, mtime unchanged afterward; 3) `mnemonik-mcp install` — verify writes ~/.claude.json (and any other present host configs) and stdout ends with 'If any of these agents is already running, please restart them.'; 4) Open Claude Code (or Cursor); 5) Verify mnemonik tools visible in /mcp menu; 6) Ask in agent session 'What can mnemonik help me with?' — agent should reach skill manifest content.

manual_steps_for_user.title: AC11 live OAuth browser popup

manual_steps_for_user.steps: 1) Authenticate as a test owner via webapp; 2) `sign_memory {mode: 'participate', visibility: 'public', content: 'post-deploy-fixture <UUID>'}` — capture attestation_id A; 3) `sign_memory {mode: 'participate', visibility: 'private', content: 'post-deploy-fixture <UUID>'}` — capture attestation_id B; 4) Anonymously: `curl -X POST https://mcp.mnemonik.xyz/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"mnemonic_recall","arguments":{"query":"post-deploy-fixture <UUID>","limit":5}}}'`; 5) Assert response includes A and excludes B.

manual_steps_for_user.title: AC17 doctor on fresh + corrupted-binary detection
manual_steps_for_user.steps: After M1: 1) Run `mnemonik-mcp doctor` — all 6 checks should report pass; exit 0; 2) Locate the cached binary (under `~/.local/share/@mnemonik-xyz/mcp/` or platform-equivalent); 3) Overwrite first 10 bytes with random data: `dd if=/dev/urandom of=<cached binary> bs=1 count=10 conv=notrunc`; 4) Re-run `mnemonik-mcp doctor` — expect exit 1, binary-integrity check FAIL, repair hint present pointing to re-install.

follow-up-1.title: Shim's `gh attestation verify` flag combination is incompatible with current gh CLI
follow-up-1.severity: minor — does not block v0.2.3 release
follow-up-1.evidence: The shim's install-binary.ts per Decision 8 invokes `gh attestation verify <tarball> --owner mnemonik-xyz --repo mnemonik-xyz/monorepo --signer-workflow .github/workflows/release.yml`. Current `gh` CLI (verified during this QA) rejects `--owner` + `--repo` together with error: 'if any flags in the group [owner repo] are set none of the others can be'. The production attestation itself is valid — verified live with `--repo mnemonik-xyz/monorepo` alone. Suggest the shim drop `--owner` (it's redundant when `--repo` is specified, since the repo path already encodes the owner) in a v0.2.4 patch.
follow-up-1.action: Track as a v0.2.4 patch issue. Not blocking — first user install will fail attestation verification on machines with current gh CLI. Recommend fast-follow.

findings.title: Shim's gh attestation verify command will fail on current gh CLI versions due to mutually-exclusive --owner + --repo flags
findings.expected: gh attestation verify succeeds with the publisher-pinned flag set described in Decision 8
findings.actual: gh attestation verify rejects --owner + --repo combined (post-shim-author gh CLI change). Verification works with --repo alone, and the buildDefinition.externalParameters.workflow.path field in the attestation JSON still confirms the signer workflow pin.
findings.reproduction: Download mnemonic-mcp-v0.2.3-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz from GitHub Release v0.2.3; run `gh attestation verify <tarball> --owner mnemonik-xyz --repo mnemonik-xyz/monorepo --signer-workflow .github/workflows/release.yml`. Observe error 'if any flags in the group [owner repo] are set none of the others can be'.
findings.recommendation: Patch packages/mcp/src/install-binary.ts to drop the --owner flag (--repo already encodes ownership); release as v0.2.4.
